mods.name: FR Resource Cache
mods.summary: FR Resource Cache improves startup performance by allowing Fast Rendering to reuse a persistent cache instead of repeatedly reading thousands of small files from installed mod folders. It preserves Fast Rendering's resource resolution and mod precedence.
mods.aiSummary: Improves startup performance by caching resources for Fast Rendering.
mods.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98a-RC8] Mikohime Unofficial Java 28+ & FR Resource Cache & OpenAL Add-on

mods.name: Mikohime Unofficial Java 28+ Configurator
mods.summary: This is an unofficial, self-contained Mikohime package with a guided configurator. It sets up Starsector to use Java 17, Java 27, or Java 28 and generates the launcher and configuration files for you. The required Mikohime files are included with permission from the original author, Yue (Himemiko).
mods.aiSummary: Sets up Starsector to run with modern Java versions using a guided configurator.
